capabilities: Difference/system GMM, corrected two-step errors, AR and Hansen diagnostics, collapsed instruments
limitation: Moment restrictions and instrument proliferation are scientific choices; package model search cannot validate them
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Short panel, outcome lags, predetermined/exogenous regressors and explicit GMM/IV lag sets.
scientific_qualification.output: Difference/system GMM coefficients, corrected two-step uncertainty and AR/Hansen diagnostics.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Lag orthogonality, serial-correlation and initial-condition restrictions; system moments require additional level restrictions.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Require an instrument ledger with count/lag depth/collapse choices. Automated model search and a nonrejected Hansen test do not establish valid moments or sufficient strength.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Compare sample moments to an independently built instrument matrix; add serial correlation and instrument proliferation; report bias and coverage alongside AR/Hansen output.

evidence.finding: Dynamic panel equation, GMM families, transformations, corrected SE, diagnostics and explicit command syntax.
